test_gtn_equal: test the gtn.equal function to check if two graphs are structurally identical
test_gtn_isomorphic: test the gtn.isomorphic function to check if two graphs have the same structure
test_gtn_loadtxt: test the gtn.loadtxt function to load a graph from a text file
test_gtn_savetxt: test the gtn.savetxt function to save a graph to a text file
test_gtn_loadsave: test the gtn.save and gtn.load functions for binary graph serialization
